notes_for_editor: The 1959 move from Swiftcurrent Ridge and the 1986 loss come only from firelookout.com; the Forest Lookouts list confirms removal without a date. Swiftcurrent Ridge (firelookout.com) is not reconciled with the Swiftcurrent Mountain site at 35N-17W-13 (Forest Lookouts list). The 1936 Swiftcurrent fire lookout in the NRHP nomination is a different structure: 10-foot tower, wood-frame cab. The NRHP nomination is undated in our read; this story does not state its listing date. A WebSearch for the 1959 move and 1986 removal returned no page that confirms them. A 2006 fire in the Red Eagle drainage appeared in search snippets only and is not used.
